This is a repaired restatement, but I have not compiled it and it may still fail the axiom check.

Attempt 1 failed with `sorryAx`. That comes from `binaryNearestCodewordPromise`, whose `disjoint` field is `by sorry`. Any theorem whose statement mentions that constant inherits `sorryAx`, including the original side, so I may not be able to avoid it. This version at least stops the restated side from mentioning the promise problem or `PromiseReduction`. It unfolds both into explicit conditions on the reduction map.
